q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gyorin Formation, using both energy to gain 10 Block now and 6 Block at the start of my next turn. Against Nibbit's telegraphed 12 damage, this leaves me taking only 2 damage and keeps the enemy at 34 HP.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Coral Guard followed by All Streams Flow to the Sea, which would give 5 Block and deal 9 damage, but it would leave me taking 7 damage instead of 2 and would not provide the next-turn Block from Gyorin Formation.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up all damage this turn and any Hydro application. It leaves Nibbit at full 34 HP and spends both energy on defense instead of dealing 9 or 15 damage.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had telegraphed a non-attack or a much smaller attack, I would have leaned more toward playing Water's Edge and All Streams Flow to the Sea for 15 damage, or at least Coral Guard plus an attack. The 12 damage intent is what makes Gyorin Formation's 10 Block the clear survival play.
